messages:
ash-support: heads-up — support case #2379 (Fresco) reporting widespread 5xx and timeouts against hosted API since ~11:10 UTC. p95 latency jumped from ~2.8s to 8–15s and then 504s. customer supplied curl repro + partial logs.

kyle-sre: I see the alert spike at 11:12 (hosted.gateway.504_rate). Grafana shows ingress_queue_depth per-shard spiked to ~12.5k, backlog exceeded watermark. Likely continuous-batcher backlog / queue saturation.

ian-eng-runtime: can you paste the repro curl + any gateway logs you have?

ash-support: repro we ran locally for them (shortened):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" -d '{"model":"redwood-l7","inputs":"short prompt","max_tokens":512}' --max-time 30
```
Response: 504 gateway timeout. Customer log snippet shows: 
```text
batcher: backlog=12560, watermark=8192, dequeue_timeout=20s, kv_miss=0.12
gateway: ingress_queue_depth=12560 shard=gw-07
```

maria-devex: quick mitigation suggestions: 1) enable small-model fallback for Fresco (to reduce token length / batch weight), 2) lower global batch window for hosted ephemeral routing to 10ms, 3) temporarily bump ingress queue_depth limit for affected shards so we don't drop while flushing. Can we do hotfixes? :wrench:

kyle-sre: I'll run temp mitigations. Runbook: (A) pause tenant burst allowances for Fresco, (B) increase ingress.queue.max_depth on gateway from 8192 -> 13000 (hot config), (C) rolling restart of batcher pods to flush backlog. Doing (B) now. @ops-bot will record the change.

ops-bot: config update accepted — ingress.queue.max_depth changed to 13000 by kyle-sre at 11:45 UTC.

kyle-sre: after change queue depth is dropping on gw-07 (12.5k -> 3.2k over 6m), 5xx rate down from ~7/min to ~0.8/min. Customer reports fewer timeouts. Still seeing some dequeue_timeouts in batcher traces; we need root cause.

ian-eng-runtime: initial hypothesis: a tenant produced many long-sequence requests and our continuous batching heuristics increased effective batch sizes + KV-cache churn leading to slower dequeue. Next steps: collect batch latency traces, check per-tenant kvcache miss rate and per-shard batch sizes. Assigning eng-runtime oncall -> @ian-eng-runtime to own RCA.

maria-devex: please also create a short customer-friendly update. I told Fresco we enabled smaller-model fallback + temporary queue bump, and they'll confirm stability. :relieved:

ian-eng-runtime: diagnostics and useful queries:
Prometheus: 
- sum(rate(hosted_gateway_5xx_total[5m])) by (code)
- max(hosted_gateway_ingress_queue_depth) by (shard)
- sum(rate(batcher_dequeue_timeouts[5m])) by (tenant)
Kubectl logs snippet to grep for: 
- "batcher: backlog=|dequeue_timeout|watermark"
Example logs we saw: 
```text
batcher: backlog=12560, watermark=8192, dequeue_timeout=20s, kv_miss=0.12
gateway: ingress_queue_depth=12560 shard=gw-07
```

ash-support: thanks all — customer said things look much better after the change, will confirm 24h. Closing the support escalation once Fresco gives final confirmation.

maria-devex: follow-up ticket created: ENG-4321 — implement a guard to reduce batch window when per-tenant queue depth > 80% and add per-tenant backpressure metrics. Assigning to eng-runtime priority P2.

ian-eng-runtime: noted. I'll attach traces and a proposed patch to the ticket once we have the batcher flamegraphs.

ash-support: marking this thread resolved from support POV for now, re-open if errors reappear. :white_check_mark:
